x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given the CRM integration runs, When a new account and contact are created in CRM, Then they exist in ServiceNow within the agreed interval with the CRM ID Given an install base item is linked to an account, When an agent opens the account, Then its products and entitlements are shown
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: The customer data model (accounts/contacts or consumers, products, install base) is populated from the system of record
